{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  fmt:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: cargo clippy --all --tests --all-features -- -D warnings

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust:
          - stable

    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: sudo apt-get install libssl-dev

      - name: Install cargo-hack
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-hack

      - name: Check
        run: cargo hack check --feature-powerset --all-targets

      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --release

  test-msvr:
    name: Test MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust:
          - 1.85.0

    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: sudo apt-get install libssl-dev

      - name: Disable env_logger dev-dependency (cargo 1.68.2 workaround)
        run: sed -i 's/env_logger/#env_logger/' Cargo.toml

      - name: Check
        run: cargo check

  autobahn:
    name: Autobahn tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust:
          - stable
          - beta
          - nightly

    steps:
      - name: Checkout sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}

      - name: Running Autobahn TestSuite for client
        run: ./scripts/autobahn-client.sh

      - name: Running Autobahn TestSuite for server
        run: ./scripts/autobahn-server.sh", "rationale": "The workflow is a Rust CI pipeline with no dependency cache. Every job that compiles code (clippy, test, test-msvr, autobahn) re-downloads crates from the cargo registry on each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) is supported by observational evidence from the ICSE 2024 GitHub Actions workflows study, which reports modest aggregate VM-time savings from caching dependency downloads. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs on every run, and Cargo.toml (confirmed present in the repository) can serve as a cache-key input. The change adds actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git before cargo commands in the jobs that compile, using Cargo.toml as the cache key with a restore-key fallback. No build or test steps are removed, no permissions are weakened, no secrets or deployment operations are added, and no new network access beyond the existing GitHub Actions cache service is introduced. The fmt job is excluded because cargo fmt does not compile or download dependencies, so caching would add overhead without benefit.", "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
